text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P3 ownership/migration RFE, with later local-publication ruling explicit. Read current accepted Eidolon ADR0001: reusable scientific Spec/Plan/Kernel/Result/FormatReceipt belongs in ScalaFIM; saved programs, operational task placement/retry/lifecycle belong in Eidolon. However the later ScalaFIM estimate-set plan explicitly assigns generic staged-object transactions, digest verification and serialized/CAS local commits to archive and requires standalone local estimate writing. Therefore the original blanket publication-state wording must not remove native format-integrity transactions or require Eidolon for local readers/writers. Continue classifying affected workflow tasks by this concrete seam; keep no ScalaFIM->Eidolon dependency and preserve scientific validation/reference interpreters. Current pipeline/fmri-workflow still exist, so the architecture migration is not already implemented; tracker refinement alone does not complete it. Consumer milestones remain foreign provenance until independently adopted. No cross-repo edits or migration implementation in this assessment.
